verdict.rationale: Windows' own support documentation lists 'Desktop Themes' under Personalization, which indicates a first-party theming capability. That one link title is the only evidence; nothing describes the themes or how switching works. missing for 10: evidence of multiple built-in themes, evidence of instant switching, evidence that themes restyle the whole desktop (colors, wallpaper, sounds, UI chrome), in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
